notes: *Ye that fear* is the anarthrous substantive's own supplied noun phrase under rule 46, headed on *fear*; the *ye*s of the two imperatives stand after their verbs and are the verbs' under rule 36.

The article of `הַלֵּוִי` is `unrepresented` because the ASV writes no *the* anywhere in that phrase (rule 29), and `יְהוָה` after `יִרְאֵי` takes no *of*, the participle having been written as an English verb (rule 19).
